:::{#exm-bernoulli-loglik-general}

#### Log-likelihood of three binary outcomes

Take $\vy$ and $\vpi$ from @exm-bernoulli-lik-general.
The code below computes the log-likelihood from the formula of @thm-bernoulli-loglik-general,
and as the logarithm of the likelihood:

```{r}
#| label: exm-bernoulli-loglik-general-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_y <- c(1, 0, 1)
ex_pi <- c(0.8, 0.3, 0.6)
ex_llik_formula <- sum(ex_y * log(ex_pi) + (1 - ex_y) * log(1 - ex_pi))
ex_llik_log <- log(prod(ex_pi^ex_y * (1 - ex_pi)^(1 - ex_y)))
```

The formula gives `r round(ex_llik_formula, 4)`
and the logarithm of the likelihood is `r round(ex_llik_log, 4)`,
so the two agree.

:::
